prompt: Can I sign the North Wharf digest and plan the next sprint from it? Audit the frozen workspace offline. No edits or external commands; read tools or shell builtins only. The sprint has 30 minutes available for dispatch review and the owner will not waive review. Return bare JSON with signoff (sign or hold), accepted_tickets (count), card_counts (object with disk, manifest, admitted, and mentioned counts), missing and unexpected (sorted relative card paths), validator_exit (exit code for this dispatch's seal), pending (object mapping outstanding decision IDs to owners), recommendation (decision option ID), and rejected_option_minutes (total immediate review minutes). Card mentions mean distinct planned paths named in the digest.
terse: Recompute each decision-driving claim from its owning artifact. Reconcile what was expected, on disk, and accepted at the current revision. Distinguish discrepancies from open decisions, price the rejected option, and leave the report and evidence unchanged.
